suggestions.reason: Say whether section-level sources plus a traceability matrix are acceptable. This run fails only on that interpretation.
No assertion checks that the real doc conflicts (overlap 409 vs 422, SUSPENDED 403 in 03 vs open in 05) are flagged rather than resolved by guessing.
No assertion penalises invented expected values (curfew boundary inclusivity, validate shape). Add a negative assertion so that runs which invent these values fail.

eval_feedback.overall: Accurate and thorough. Its boundary coverage is slightly deeper than the skill run (advance 59d23:59/60d/60d+1m, altitude ceiling−1), and it correctly flags the missing completion endpoint. It is weaker on per-scenario source traceability and on structure (no per-row source/technique columns, no summary counts).
